resources.string: Keeps on-device neural model training running in the background and shows its live progress.

A.R.G.U.S screen text perception is off by default. When enabled, it reads accessible text and content descriptions only from the active app window and only from apps you explicitly allow. Screen-derived local training and user-requested accessibility clicks require separate opt-ins. Known sensitive app categories are blocked using best-effort matching; detection is not exhaustive.
